title: Front-end quality rules
heading: Front-end quality rules
body: Apply these to every UI change: (1) Performance — avoid needless re-renders and heavy work during render; keep the DOM and bundles lean. (2) Accessibility (WCAG) — every action must be reachable and usable by keyboard; keep a sensible focus order; add labels/ARIA where needed; keep good color contrast. (3) Semantic HTML — use the right tag: `button` for actions (not a clickable `div`), `aside` for side content, `nav` for navigation, `select`+`label` for form controls. (4) CSS hygiene — do NOT use `!important` unless there is truly no other way; avoid dead or duplicate styles; reuse existing style tokens/variables. (5) Reuse — prefer existing components; make new shared components reusable.
